answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks via a stake-weighted reputation trellis where each identity bonds capital to a mesa of validated attestations. Entrants submit a zero-knowledge cipher proving unique resource control; the protocol verifies against the trellis, slashing bonds for duplicate claims. Attackers face quadratic costs: N identities require N² distinct resource commitments, making large-scale farming irrational while preserving pseudonymity.
